title: AI Study Tool Login
scenario: A student Discord post offers premium AI study access if you use your university login.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: AI Study Tool Login: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: School credentials should only be entered on official systems.
